verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated Identity API that returns beneficial owner identity information for each account the end-user authorized [teller-docs-4][teller-docs-19]. The homepage also markets account ownership verification [teller-docs-1], which directly supports matching the account owner against a customer. missing for 10: an explicit field listing confirming names, postal addresses, and contact data (phone/email) are returned, and independent or hands-on corroboration of identity data quality.
